events.title: Tupac Shakur's Tragic Anniversary
events.blurb: Remembering Tupac Shakur, who was tragically shot in Las Vegas in 1996, and would have been 55 today.

angles.name: Remembering an icon
angles.copy: Thirty years since the music world lost a true icon. Still influencing generations.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix: A Guitar Legend Remembered
events.blurb: On this day in 1970, the world lost guitar icon Jimi Hendrix, who would have been 84.

angles.name: Still electrifying
angles.copy: The legendary Jimi Hendrix left us on this day in 1970, but his music still electrifies generations.

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic 'Abbey Road' album on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Still crossing that road
angles.copy: The one with THAT album cover. The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' turns another year older today!

events.title: Chrissie Hynde Turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, frontwoman of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Rock icon
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the incredible Chrissie Hynde! Still a force of nature in rock music.

events.title: Liam Gallagher Turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Still rocking the mic
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still rocking the mic and giving it some.

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's timeless anthem 'Imagine' was released on this day in 1975.

angles.name: A song that still resonates
angles.copy: Fifty-one years ago today, John Lennon released 'Imagine'. A song that still resonates with its powerful message.

events.title: The Original iPod's 25th Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple introduced the revolutionary first-generation iPod on this day in 2001.

angles.name: Remember life before?
angles.copy: Twenty-five years ago, Apple dropped the original iPod. Remember life before you could carry all your music in your pocket?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: Celebrating James Bond Day, marking the anniversary of 'Dr. No's' premiere in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, not stirred
angles.copy: It's James Bond Day! What's your favourite Bond film, song, or iconic moment? Mine's shaken, not stirred.

events.title: John Lennon Would Have Been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Still inspiring millions
angles.copy: Remembering the legendary John Lennon, who would have been 86 today. Still inspiring millions around the world.

events.title: John Cleese Turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Still making us laugh
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! Still making us laugh with his timeless comedy.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking double album, officially titled 'The Beatles', on this day in 1968.

angles.name: Still as diverse as ever
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago, The Beatles gave us the 'White Album'. Still as diverse and influential as ever.

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: On this day in 1991, the world lost Queen frontman Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80.

angles.name: Champion of our hearts
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since the incomparable Freddie Mercury left us. Still the champion of our hearts.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their influential album 'Rubber Soul' on this day in 1965.

angles.name: A pivotal moment
angles.copy: A pivotal moment in pop music history! The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' was released on this day in 1965.
